blocks.title: System UI.
blocks.lead: The parts of the phone around the apps: the status menu, notifications, the power menu, Breeze and single hand, and the sound of the system.

items.title: Status menu
items.text: Tap the status bar: profile, volume, connectivity and battery. The rows open their settings, as on the N9; an optional strip of Belle toggles switches them, with an edit mode.

items.title: Notifications over apps
items.text: Five styles: Discreet (the N9’s), Belle strip, Card, Colour or Android.

items.title: Profiles
items.text: Do Not Disturb and Modes are shown as N9 profiles, with priority people.

items.title: Privacy
items.text: An N9-style privacy indicator, the N9 permission dialog and a screen recorder tile.

items.title: Copied
items.text: A small “Copied” bubble when text goes to the clipboard.

items.title: Private space and app pinning
items.text: Android’s private space and app pinning, kept and restyled.

items.title: Breeze
items.text: A floating button, or an edge handle, with a menu of shortcuts and widgets, its own editor, sizes and settings. It replaces Side Sense.

items.title: Single hand
items.text: The whole screen at half size, with a size slider or corners only. Tap the empty space to move it; double tap for full screen.

items.title: Back side
items.text: Which side Back sits on is a system setting.

items.title: Power menu
items.text: The N9 power menu. The squircle shutdown spinner.

items.title: Standby screen
items.text: An N9-style standby screen: the clock, the weather, notification icons and items, moving every minute against burn-in.

items.title: Etesian’s own sounds
items.text: Interface sounds and tones made for Etesian: wind on N9 moments only (long press, edit mode, the status bar, closing), silent taps, and Etesian ringtone, message, mail, calendar and alarm tones.

items.title: Boot animation
items.text: A water-drop boot animation made for Etesian.
